what: conv1 filters (96 x 11 x 11 x 3) of a small AlexNet-like CNN trained from scratch for this film
dataset: CIFAR-10 (50,000 train / 10,000 test, 10 classes), 32 px resampled to 64 px (bilinear); test at a plain 2x upsample
arch: conv1 96@11x11/s2 +BN+ReLU, maxpool, conv2 256@5x5 (2 groups), maxpool, conv3 384@3x3, conv4 384@3x3 (2 groups), conv5 256@3x3 (2 groups), maxpool, FC 1024, FC 10; dropout 0.5
groups: conv1 0-47 feed only group 1 and 48-95 only group 2 (the two-GPU split)
sheet_order: rows 0-3 = the 48 greyest filters (oriented ones by orientation), rows 4-7 = the 48 most colourful (by opponent axis)
training: SGD nesterov momentum 0.9, one-cycle lr max 0.05, weight decay 5e-04 (conv1 5e-03), batch 128, label smoothing 0.1; augmentation: random magnification 1.3-2x (bilinear), shift, h-flip, brightness/contrast jitter; conv1 init N(0, 2e-03)
normalisation: each filter min-max over its three channels together; gaps = ink #0B0A0D
